frostbound.building.advanced_lab.desc: Makes medicine while caring for the sick. 6 medics, 5 beds.
frostbound.building.apartment.desc: A large block for many families. Houses 24 (insulation +12°C), but draws a lot of heat.
frostbound.building.chapel.desc: A place of prayer and quiet. Hope +5 and discontent -2 for up to 60 people. 2 staff.
frostbound.building.clinic.desc: A small clinic for the sick. 4 medics, 12 beds.
frostbound.building.coal_pit.desc: Digs coal out of the frozen ground. 10 workers. The generator's fire depends on it.
frostbound.building.core_extractor.desc: Slowly digs heat cores out of the deep permafrost. 10 technicians.
frostbound.building.fishery.desc: Fishing through holes cut in the ice. 6 workers. Outdoor work, so bad weather cuts output.
frostbound.building.food_processor.desc: Processes and preserves food indoors, burning a little wood as fuel. 8 workers.
frostbound.building.generator.desc: The heart of the city. Burns coal to send heat to the buildings around it. Higher levels give more heat but burn more coal.
frostbound.building.greenhouse.desc: Grows crops under glass. 10 workers. Output halves when it is below 5°C inside.
frostbound.building.guard_post.desc: Watchmen patrol the streets. Discontent -6 for up to 60 people, doubled under Strict Control. 4 staff.
frostbound.building.heated_house.desc: A house warmed by a heat core under the floor. Houses 10 and stays warm even far from the generator (insulation +20°C).
frostbound.building.hospital.desc: A proper hospital for serious cases. 8 medics, 25 beds.
frostbound.building.hunters_lodge.desc: Hunters track game across the snowfields. 8 workers. Outdoor work, so bad weather cuts output.
frostbound.building.machine_factory.desc: Builds machines that raise the output of resource buildings by up to 12%% per factory (36%% in total). Burns coal. 8 technicians.
frostbound.building.medical_tent.desc: A tent for basic care. 2 medics, 6 beds.
frostbound.building.meeting_hall.desc: A place to gather and talk. Hope +6 for up to 60 people. 2 staff.
frostbound.building.mine.desc: Deep shafts that yield both coal and iron. 15 workers.
frostbound.building.research_lab.desc: Engineers develop new technology here. 5 engineers. Most research progress comes from labs.
frostbound.building.sawmill.desc: Cuts frozen timber into usable wood. 10 workers.
frostbound.building.school.desc: Teaches the children to read and write. Hope +4 for up to 40 people. 2 staff.
frostbound.building.steam_engine_factory: Builds engine parts that improve the generator: coal use -15%% and heat capacity +10%% when fully staffed. Uses iron. 8 engineers.
frostbound.building.steelworks.desc: Burns coal to smelt iron. 10 technicians.
frostbound.building.tavern.desc: Drink and talk ease the strain. Discontent -8 for up to 50 people. Uses a little food. 3 staff.
frostbound.building.tent.desc: A makeshift canvas shelter. Houses 6, but barely keeps out the cold (insulation +3°C).
frostbound.building.warehouse.desc: Raises the storage limit of every resource by 400 per level (heat cores: 10 per level).
frostbound.building.wooden_house.desc: A sturdy timber house. Houses 10 and keeps the cold out well (insulation +10°C).
frostbound.building.workshop.desc: Turns wood into splints, salves and other medicine. 6 technicians.
frostbound.difficulty.easy.desc: 8°C warmer and 1.6× the starting supplies. The generator burns less coal, and illness and disasters hit softer. Three cold waves.
frostbound.difficulty.hard.desc: 6°C colder and 0.7× the starting supplies. The generator burns more coal, illness and disasters hit harder, and five cold waves come.
frostbound.difficulty.normal.desc: Standard cold and supplies, with three cold waves. The challenge as intended.
frostbound.ending.city_of_steel.text: The city survived the hundred days under iron discipline. Order held, and the generator never went out. But no one can remember the last time they laughed. The city stands, cold and unbending as steel.
frostbound.ending.city_of_steel.title: City of Steel
frostbound.ending.eternal_winter.text: The city could not endure. The generator's fire has died, and snow slowly fills the empty streets. Soon no one will remember this place. The winter has no end.
frostbound.ending.eternal_winter.title: Eternal Winter
frostbound.ending.hope_of_humanity.text: The great cold wave has passed. Most of the people lived, and they still believe in tomorrow. In a frozen world, this city has become proof that humanity can endure.
frostbound.ending.hope_of_humanity.title: Hope of Humanity
frostbound.ending.last_flame.text: The city endured the hundred days, but the cost was great. Those who remain huddle around the generator's faint glow, too worn down to hope. The flame still burns. For now.
frostbound.ending.last_flame.title: The Last Flame
frostbound.ending.reason.despair: The people lost all hope and abandoned the city.
frostbound.ending.reason.revolt: Discontent boiled over into revolt. No one follows your orders any more.
frostbound.ending.rebirth.text: Knowledge saved the city. With new machines and new methods, its people learned not merely to endure the ice but to live with it. Now that the great cold has passed, they are planning a future beyond the city's edge.
frostbound.ending.rebirth.title: Rebirth
frostbound.event.cold_wave_warning.r0: The city has begun to brace for the cold wave.
frostbound.event.cold_wave_warning.text: Readings warn of a %3$s-day cold wave arriving in %1$s days. The temperature will fall to around %2$s°C.
frostbound.event.cold_wave_warning.title: Cold Wave Ahead
frostbound.event.engineer_idea.r0: The experiment worked. Research has moved forward.
frostbound.event.engineer_idea.r1: The engineer went back to work, disappointed.
frostbound.event.engineer_idea.text: One of the engineers proposes an experiment that could speed up research. Building the prototype will take iron.
frostbound.event.engineer_idea.title: An Engineer's Proposal
frostbound.event.frostbite_wave.c1: They will have to endure it
frostbound.event.frostbite_wave.r0: Warmed by the fires, %s of the frostbitten began to recover.
frostbound.event.frostbite_wave.text: Frostbite is spreading through the city. Some people's fingertips have already begun to blacken.
frostbound.event.frostbite_wave.title: Spreading Frostbite
frostbound.event.funeral.c1: There is no time for mourning
frostbound.event.funeral.r0: The city said farewell to its dead together. The grief eased a little.
frostbound.event.funeral.r1: The bodies were carried away in silence. The grief remains.
frostbound.event.funeral.text: %s people died yesterday. Those left behind ask to bury them properly.
frostbound.event.funeral.title: Mourning
frostbound.event.generator_strain.r0: The reinforcement held. The strain on the generator has eased.
frostbound.event.generator_strain.r1a: With a roar, the generator broke down. It must be repaired at once.
frostbound.event.generator_strain.text: The generator is making an ominous noise. Cracks are running along the seams of its casing, and the pressure is near its limit.
frostbound.event.generator_strain.title: Generator Under Strain
frostbound.event.great_cold_wave.r0: Fear spreads through the streets. Everyone is bracing for the worst.
frostbound.event.great_cold_wave.text: In %s days, a cold wave like no other will strike the city. Whether we survive depends on what we do now.
frostbound.event.great_cold_wave.title: The Great Cold Wave Approaches
frostbound.event.hope_crisis.c0: Speak to the people and promise them a future
frostbound.event.hope_crisis.r0: Your words lit a small light in people's hearts.
frostbound.event.hope_crisis.r1: The silence only deepened the despair.
frostbound.event.hope_crisis.text: Despair hangs over the city. More and more people are asking whether there is any point in going on.
frostbound.event.hope_crisis.title: Edge of Despair
frostbound.event.infection_outbreak.c0: Isolate the sick in the medical buildings
frostbound.event.infection_outbreak.c1: We have no room to isolate anyone
frostbound.event.infection_outbreak.r0: Isolation slowed the spread. Newly infected: %s.
frostbound.event.infection_outbreak.r1: The infection spread unchecked. Newly infected: %s.
frostbound.event.infection_outbreak.text: An infection has begun to spread among the sick. Left alone, it could reach the whole city.
frostbound.event.law_check.broken: %s was never enacted. The people feel betrayed.
frostbound.event.law_check.kept: %s is in force. You kept your promise.
frostbound.event.law_check.text: Two days have passed since you promised a new law. The people are waiting to see whether you kept your word.
frostbound.event.law_check.title: The Promised Law
frostbound.event.law_demand.c0: Promise to enact the law they ask for
frostbound.event.law_demand.r0: You promised to enact %s within two days. The people will be watching.
frostbound.event.law_demand.r1: The demand was refused. Disappointment is turning to anger.
frostbound.event.law_demand.text: Losing hope, the people have gathered to demand a law that would ease their lives.
frostbound.event.law_demand.title: Calls for a New Law
frostbound.event.lost_in_storm.c1: Wait for the storm to pass
frostbound.event.lost_in_storm.r0a: The search party brought everyone home.
frostbound.event.lost_in_storm.r0b: The missing were found, but %s died in the storm.
frostbound.event.lost_in_storm.r1: When the storm passed, they found %s frozen in the snow.
frostbound.event.lost_in_storm.text: People working outside when the storm hit have not come back. Their tracks are already vanishing under the snow.
frostbound.event.lost_in_storm.title: Lost in the Storm
frostbound.event.mining_accident.c0: Shore up the tunnel and dig them out (15 wood)
frostbound.event.mining_accident.r0: Everyone was brought out alive. Badly injured: %s.
frostbound.event.mining_accident.r1: The rescue was abandoned. %s never came out.
frostbound.event.mining_accident.text: A tunnel has collapsed at the diggings. Several workers are trapped under the rubble.
frostbound.event.mining_accident.title: Cave-In
frostbound.event.ration_check.broken: The stores were nearly empty. The promise was broken.
frostbound.event.ration_check.kept: There was enough. The promise was kept, and trust in you has grown.
frostbound.event.ration_check.text: Two days have passed since you promised more food. The people are watching the stores.
frostbound.event.ration_check.title: The Promised Meals
frostbound.event.ration_demand.c0: Promise more food within two days
frostbound.event.ration_demand.c1: Refuse: there is nothing more to give
frostbound.event.ration_demand.r0: The people have backed down for now. In two days, the stores must hold enough food.
frostbound.event.ration_demand.r1: The demand was refused. Resentment is smoldering.
frostbound.event.ration_demand.text: Complaints about the meals are growing louder. People are demanding bigger rations.
frostbound.event.ration_demand.title: Demands for Food
frostbound.event.riot.c0: Hand out food and coal (40 of each)
frostbound.event.riot.c2: Wait for it to burn out
frostbound.event.riot.r0: With their demands met, the crowd dispersed.
frostbound.event.riot.r1: The riot was crushed. %s died in the clash.
frostbound.event.riot.r2: The riot burned itself out, but the anger remains.
frostbound.event.riot.text: An angry crowd has gathered around the generator and is threatening to storm the stores.
frostbound.event.riot.title: Riot
frostbound.event.sick_child.r0: The fever broke. The parents wept with relief.
frostbound.event.sick_child.text: A child has come down with a high fever. The parents are begging for medicine.
frostbound.event.sick_child.title: A Feverish Child
frostbound.event.strike.c1: Have the guards force them back to work
frostbound.event.strike.c2: Allow the strike for one day
frostbound.event.strike.r0: With full stomachs, the workers went back to their posts.
frostbound.event.strike.r1: The guards drove everyone back to work. No one said a word.
frostbound.event.strike.r2: Work stopped for a full day. The anger cooled a little.
frostbound.event.strike.text: The workers have put down their tools. They say they will not work until things get better.
frostbound.event.strike.title: Strike
frostbound.event.survivors_arrive.r1: The survivors were turned away. No one speaks of it.
frostbound.event.survivors_arrive.text: %s survivors have reached the city, frozen and starving.
frostbound.event.survivors_arrive.title: Survivors at the Gate
frostbound.event.survivors_found.r1: They were left out on the snowfield. It weighs on everyone.
frostbound.event.survivors_found.text: The expedition found people holding out at a camp, %s in all. They ask to come to the city.
frostbound.event.survivors_found.title: Survivors Found
frostbound.event.theft.c0: Find the thieves and punish them
frostbound.event.theft.r0: The thieves were caught and punished. The stores are safe, but the mood is tense.
frostbound.event.theft.r1: The food is gone for good, but some are grateful for the mercy.
frostbound.event.theft.text: Food has gone missing from the stores. Someone saw a figure near the door in the night.
frostbound.event.theft.title: Theft from the Stores
frostbound.event.unknown_facility.r0: The records were deciphered: we have learned %s.
frostbound.event.unknown_facility.r0b: The records were incomplete, but research has moved forward.
frostbound.event.unknown_facility.r1: The team stripped the facility for iron and a heat core.
frostbound.event.unknown_facility.text: The expedition has found an intact research facility. Its records describe a technology the city has not yet mastered.
frostbound.event.unknown_facility.title: An Unknown Facility
frostbound.expedition.reason.busy: An expedition is already heading there.
frostbound.expedition.reason.depleted: Nothing of value is left there.
frostbound.expedition.reason.far: Too far. Research Long-Range Travel first.
frostbound.expedition.reason.people: Not enough healthy adults are free to go.
frostbound.expedition.reason.supplies: Not enough food and coal for the round trip.
frostbound.law.child_labor.desc: Children under 14 may do general labor at half efficiency (not medical or construction work). Hope -6, discontent +4. On enactment: hope -8, discontent +6.
frostbound.law.curfew.desc: Discontent rises 20%% slower, but hope -3 and taverns are half as effective. Unlocks the Sentry Post. On enactment: hope -3, discontent +2.
frostbound.law.emergency_shift.desc: Decree: everyone works around the clock for one day, at most once every 3 days. Fatigue and accident risk soar. On enactment: hope -3, discontent +12. Requires Overtime.
frostbound.law.entertainment.desc: Unlocks the Tavern and makes it 50%% more effective. Discontent -6, at 5 wood per day. On enactment: hope +3, discontent -5.
frostbound.law.extended_shift.desc: Shifts run until 22:00 instead of 18:00. Fatigue ×1.5, discontent +8, and mining accidents become more likely. On enactment: hope -2, discontent +5.
frostbound.law.food_rationing.desc: Food use -30%%, but meals fill people less. Hope -4, discontent +4. On enactment: hope -3, discontent +4.
frostbound.law.free_medicine.desc: Treatment for everyone, free of charge. Medicine use +30%%, healing +15%%, hope +5. On enactment: hope +5, discontent -2.
frostbound.law.medical_priority.desc: Medical buildings get heat first, and the mildly ill rest instead of working. Healing +25%%, hope +2. On enactment: hope +3.
frostbound.law.reason.conflict: Conflicts with a law already in force.
frostbound.law.reason.cooldown: Too soon since the last one. Wait a while.
frostbound.law.reason.requires: Another law must be enacted first.
frostbound.law.self_governance.desc: Citizens share in running the city. Hope +8, discontent -4, but output -5%%. On enactment: hope +8, discontent -4. Excludes Strict Control.
frostbound.law.strict_control.desc: Discontent rises half as fast, output +5%% and Sentry Posts work twice as well, but hope -8. On enactment: hope -8, discontent -6. Requires Curfew; excludes Self-Governance.
frostbound.msg.day_started: Day %1$s begins. Population in the city: %2$s.
frostbound.msg.ending: The hundred days are over. Ending: %s
frostbound.msg.endless: The city carries on beyond the hundred days.
frostbound.msg.expedition_left: An expedition of %2$s set out for %1$s.
frostbound.msg.expedition_losses: The expedition to %1$s suffered losses: %2$s dead.
frostbound.msg.food_shortage: Food shortage: only %s%% of the meal could be served.
frostbound.msg.generator_broke: The generator has broken down! It needs repair.
frostbound.msg.generator_fuel_out: Out of coal. The generator has gone cold.
frostbound.msg.generator_fuel_restored: Coal is flowing again. The generator is running.
frostbound.msg.law_upkeep_failed: Could not pay the upkeep for %s. Discontent is rising.
frostbound.msg.overload_on: Generator overload on. Watch the strain.
frostbound.msg.warn_coal: Coal is running low. The generator may go out.
frostbound.msg.warn_food: Food is running out. Less than a day's worth is left.
frostbound.msg.warn_sick: Illness is spreading: %s people are sick.
frostbound.reason.game_over: This city's story has already ended.
frostbound.reason.generator_max: The generator only goes up to level %s.
frostbound.reason.locked: Not unlocked yet. Requires research or a law.
frostbound.reason.no_event: There is no event to respond to.
frostbound.reason.no_permission: You don't have permission to do that.
frostbound.reason.not_ended: You can only carry on after surviving the hundred days.
frostbound.reason.overlap: Too close to another building. Leave a gap of at least 1 block.
frostbound.reason.terrain: The ground here is not suitable for building.
frostbound.reason.too_far: Too far from the generator (160 blocks at most).
frostbound.reason.upgrading: An upgrade is already under way.
frostbound.site.abandoned_mine.desc: A deserted mine with plenty of coal and some iron left. Beware of cave-ins.
frostbound.site.abandoned_town.desc: The remains of a town buried in snow. Wood, iron, food and sometimes medicine. Fairly safe.
frostbound.site.glacier_cave.desc: Caves deep inside the glacier. Heat cores can be found here, but few places are more dangerous.
frostbound.site.old_factory.desc: A factory shut down long ago. Iron and coal remain.
frostbound.site.research_facility.desc: A distant, abandoned research station. Iron, medicine and research notes, perhaps even an unknown technology.
frostbound.site.resource_site.desc: Untouched ground with coal and wood to gather.
frostbound.site.survivor_camp.desc: A camp where survivors are holding out. They might join the city.
frostbound.tech.advanced_medicine.desc: Unlocks the Advanced Medical Lab, which makes medicine. All healing +25%%.
frostbound.tech.apartments.desc: Unlocks the Apartment Block, which houses 24 people.
frostbound.tech.clinic.desc: Unlocks the Clinic: 12 beds, run by 4 medics.
frostbound.tech.cold_suits.desc: Halves the risk of losing people on expeditions.
frostbound.tech.core_extraction.desc: Unlocks the Core Extractor, which slowly digs up heat cores.
frostbound.tech.deep_mining.desc: Unlocks the Mine, which yields both coal and iron.
frostbound.tech.food_processing.desc: Unlocks the Food Factory, which produces food indoors whatever the weather.
frostbound.tech.gen_level4.desc: Lets the generator run at level 4: more heat and range, but it burns far more coal.
frostbound.tech.gen_range.desc: The generator's heat reaches 8 blocks farther.
frostbound.tech.greenhouse.desc: Unlocks the Greenhouse. Keep it above 5°C inside, or its output halves.
frostbound.tech.heat_boost.desc: The generator warms buildings 6°C more, and its heat capacity rises by 10%%.
frostbound.tech.heated_houses.desc: Unlocks the Heated House, which stays warm even far from the generator.
frostbound.tech.hospital.desc: Unlocks the Hospital: 25 beds, run by 8 medics.
frostbound.tech.hunting_gear.desc: Hunting camps and ice fisheries bring in 25%% more food.
frostbound.tech.machine_factory.desc: Unlocks the Machine Factory, which raises the output of resource buildings.
frostbound.tech.steam_engine_factory.des: Unlocks the Steam Engine Works, which makes the generator burn less coal and give more heat.
frostbound.tech.wooden_houses.desc: Unlocks the Wooden House, warmer than tents and shelters.
frostbound.tutorial.assign_workers: Open a building and set how many workers it should have.
frostbound.tutorial.build_housing: Build housing from the build menu so no one has to sleep in the cold.
frostbound.tutorial.done: Tutorial complete. The city's fate is in your hands now.
frostbound.tutorial.enact_law: Enact a law. Laws shape your citizens' hope and discontent.
frostbound.tutorial.generator: Raise the generator's level. It gives more heat but burns more coal.
frostbound.tutorial.open_management: Press M to open the management screen.
frostbound.tutorial.start_research: Start a research project. Staff a Research Lab with engineers to make progress.
frostbound.tutorial.welcome: Welcome to the last city. Keep the generator burning and survive for 100 days.
